title: lab 102 - 2026
description: Launch Multiple AWS EC2 Linux Instances

lab_objective.description: By the end of this lab, you will be able to:
objectives: Log in to the AWS Management Console
Create two EC2 Linux instances where Apache HTTP Server (httpd) is already installed and running
Create a Linux user named john automatically during instance launch
Configure instance automatically using an EC2 User Data script
Connect to the instance using SSH
Terminate the instances to avoid unnecessary charges

tasks.title: Login to AWS Management Console
steps: After login you will see the AWS Console

tasks.title: Select AWS Region
tasks.instruction: Keep the same region throughout the lab.

tasks.title: Create Key Pair
steps: Download and save the key pair

tasks.title: Configure EC2 User Data Script
tasks.location: Click Advanced Details and scroll down to User data (optional)
tasks.script:
#!/bin/bash # Install Apache Web Server dnf install httpd -y # Start and enable Apache service systemctl start httpd systemctl enable httpd # Create default web page echo "

Welcome to my AWS Web Server

" > /var/www/html/index.html # Create Linux user useradd john

tasks.title: Launch Two EC2 Instances
steps: Under Number of instances, change the value from 1 to 2
tasks.expected_result: Two EC2 instances should be created using the same configuration and User Data script.

tasks.title: Verify Instance Status
steps: Wait until both instances are running
verification: Some instance types may display 3/3 checks passed

tasks.title: Update Instance Tags
steps: Keep the first instance name unchanged as myweb01
Change the second instance tag/name to myweb02

tasks.title: Copy Public IPv4 Addresses
tasks.instruction: Copy the Public IPv4 Address of both instances for SSH connection and web testing.

tasks.title: Connect to EC2 Instances Using Private Key
steps: Add Public IP of EC2 instance as Remote host

tasks.title: Test SSH Access From Command Line
Verify myweb01 Web Server
tasks.expected_result: Welcome to my AWS Web Server

tasks.title: Verify myweb02 Web Server
tasks.expected_result: Welcome to my AWS Web Server

tasks.title: Disconnect From EC2 Instances
steps: Disconnect from EC2 instances using Mobaxterm, CLI, or Terminal
